posts.author: Roli
posts.body:
Like many I've been reading the forums for some time, and I found a lot of help here in the last few days since I got RPG Maker MZ. Right now, I'm just learning the basics, really.
A long time ago
, I messed around a little bit with RPG Maker XP and made some terrible graphics in a program called GraphicsGale, but from there I went on to work on more boring web stuff, mostly CSS and some JS.
Anyway, I feel very grateful for the many helpful things I've been reading here, and I wanted to join

posts.author: alice_gristle
posts.body:
Hi there sweetie, welcome aboard!
Glad to hear you've found the forums helpful!

posts.author: ZombieKidzRule
posts.body:
Welcome! Sounds like you have at least some background which can only help. And knowing or learning some JS can be very useful.
I hope you love learning and using MZ as much as I do.
Good luck on your projects and remember to enjoy what you do!
